clips.title: The story
paras: Collin Mauren is a human mage residing in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City. A scholarly researcher and crafter of incantations, he experiments with exotic natural reagents to devise unique utility spells. Among his pursuits is assisting his acquaintance, the gnome engineer and explorer Gaxim Rustfizzle, with specialized arcane scrolls.

Situated within Stormwind's bustling Mage Quarter, Collin Mauren spends his days pursuing the quieter, more practical applications of magic. Rather than chasing raw elemental power, he focuses on crafting arcane formulas that solve specific, logistical problems. Collin often turns to natural anomalies and raw components scavenged across Azeroth, weaving their intrinsic properties into functional magic scrolls and reagents for friends and travelers alike.
